For every associative rational algebra the adjoint is explicitly defined as rational-linear left multiplication minus right multiplication. The two operators commute, and their nilpotency follows from actual element powers. The finite exponential of their difference is computed by the commuting exponential theorem, yielding exp(ad_x)(y)=exp(x)*y*exp(-x). This is a proved finite Hadamard identity, not an assumed group/Lie adjoint relation or BCH formula.

For every actual Lie subalgebra V of the associative algebra, bracket closure proves that all powers of the constructed commutator endomorphism preserve V. Restricting scalars to the rationals proves the finite exponential sum also preserves V. This auxiliary finite-polynomial closure theorem needs no nilpotency premise because IsNilpotent.exp is a total finite-sum definition; the actual Hadamard/conjugation theorems do require the element to be associative-nilpotent. Product closure of V is never assumed.

Conjugation by exp(x) for x in V and associative-nilpotent x preserves V in both directions. The reverse implication is proved by actual exp(-x) multiplication and exp(-x)*exp(x)=1. This works beyond matrices and beyond finite-dimensional algebras; it does not assert arbitrary abstract nilpotent Lie algebras embed in an associative algebra.

Its powers agree coefficientwise with the ambient rational-linear commutator powers and raise an initial support depth k to k+m. Matrix support termination derives adjoint^(n-1)=0 and a genuine IsNilpotent instance. Restricting the actual Hadamard formula then gives the exact finite series with indices below n-1. For every actual matrix Lie subalgebra contained in the strict algebra, its logarithm-defined exponential image is proved equal to the image of its actual internal strict matrices. Actual exponential inverse and logarithm conjugation identities prove inversion and internal exponential conjugation preserve image membership. This does not claim closure under arbitrary noncommuting multiplication.

The one, multiplication and inverse laws for actual matrix conjugation are proved using the constructed ConjAct matrix-units action. They construct a genuine conjugation stabilizer Subgroup, with no supplied stabilizer or invariance field. Its containment of the subgroup generated by the exponential image follows from the proved internal Hadamard invariance and Subgroup.closure_le. Every generated element therefore preserves V and the actual exponential image under conjugation. Subgroup.closure here means algebraic generation, not topological closure.

For real coefficients the restricted exponential equivalence/homeomorphism is constructed with the proved actual logarithm as inverse, in the original natural subtype topologies. Its linear domain is V.comap of the strict-matrix inclusion; it represents V intersected with the strict algebra when V is not assumed contained in it. For V contained in the strict algebra it is exactly exp(V), rather than a surrogate subset or supplied homeomorphism.

The actual linear domain is closed by finite-dimensional matrix subspace closedness. Its actual exponential image is a continuous logarithm preimage and is therefore closed. Nonempty convexity of the linear domain and the constructed homeomorphism prove the image contractible, simply connected, path connected and connected. No compactness, cocompactness, Lie manifold structure or multiplication closure follows merely from this topology.

Continuity of actual matrix conjugation in the group element and closedness of the real linear V prove the constructed stabilizer closed. The proof uses both forward and inverse preservation of V, not an unproved equality of exponential image and generated subgroup.
